description: Is this email address real and safe to send to? Returns status (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown, invalid), reason, and 0-100 score. Checks syntax, domain and MX records, asks the mail server whether the mailbox exists (no email is sent), detects catch-all domains, disposable/throwaway providers, role accounts (info@, support@), free providers, and suggests typo fixes (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).
name: email_verify
title: Email verification
